answers.rationale: The requirement specifies power controls at various levels and reaction times, which aligns with the capabilities of the FPM-DCPDU product. This product provides advanced power distribution and control features suitable for high-power systems.

The requirement for energy measurement and system monitoring aligns with the capabilities of the ANORD-PMS product, which provides power management and monitoring systems with real-time data collection and analysis.

The requirement for system resilience and rolling upgrades aligns with the capabilities of the CLOUD-INT product, which supports integrated and tested rack-scale systems with high availability and reliability.
This is a compliance requirement related to security standards and policies, which does not directly map to a product. The bid manager should address this.
The requirement for storage systems does not directly map to any listed product in the catalog. The bid manager should propose a solution or clarify further.
The requirement for control-plane network separation and secure partitioning does not directly map to any listed product in the catalog. The bid manager should propose a solution or clarify further.
The requirement for software features does not directly map to any listed product in the catalog. The bid manager should propose a solution or clarify further.
This is a technical requirement related to utility interconnection, which does not directly map to a product. The bid manager should address this.
The requirement for busduct and busway aligns with the capabilities of the ANORD-BUSWAY product, which provides enclosed busway systems suitable for high-current distribution.
